snippet.title: HitTube Demo - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
HitTube is a satirical open-world roguelike looter shooter. You're a post-apocalyptic video blogger who fights for donations while streaming your survival. 

✨ Wishlist and follow HitTube on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3347830/HitTube/✨
